name: apple-card-carousel
title: Apple Card Carousel
description: A sideways scroller of tall image cards, each labelled with a category and a big title. Clicking one expands it into a large centred panel with the description and a small close button over a blurred dark backdrop.
use: Image-led items should be browsed sideways and open into a longer description in place.
avoid: Cards sit at fixed pixel widths and pull remote photos, so you must supply your own imagery.
a11y: Cards are buttons and Escape closes the overlay, but the close button has no label and focus is not trapped. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Tall portrait photo cards sit in a row on a dark page, softly rounded, with a small white category label and a large white title at the top left over a dark fade. Two round arrow buttons rest at the lower right; an open card becomes a wide light panel centred on a dimmed backdrop.
behaves: Arrows and trackpad drag slide the row horizontally, and the arrows dim when there is nothing further to scroll. Clicking a card expands it into a large detail panel; the close button, Escape or a click outside folds it away.
customise: Feed nodes through items with an optional initialScroll; each card takes src, title, category and content, while sizes and overlay styling stay in the source.
weight: light: Five lazy-loaded images and one layout animation, idle until a card is clicked.
demo: Travel cards Mountain Peaks, Ocean Waves, Forest Path and Desert Dunes under the heading 'Explore the World'.
issues: Frames 1, 4 and 5 catch the row scrolled so the section heading is cut off at the left edge.
Frames 2 and 5 show the detail overlay mid-fade as an almost blank dark panel.
polishWhy: Strong photos and card proportions; blank transition frames and a clipped heading.
